transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Friday, October 30. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. Bhutan lake outburst triggers flash flood alert along Sankosh river in Bengal. Bengal forest minister Manoj Oraon issued a warning to residents near the Sankosh river. This warning follows an outburst from Shintaphu Lake in Bhutan. Residents living in Kumargram area have been advised to remain alert to rising water levels. Local authorities have begun relocating affected individuals to safer areas for their protection. Rashid Khan enters record books! Becomes first bowler to achieve historic T20I feat. Rashid Khan achieved a historic milestone by taking his 200th T20I wicket during a match against Zimbabwe. The moment occurred in Sharjah as he dismissed Tadiwanashe Marumani for only two runs. Azmatullah Omarzai played a crucial role, scoring 116 runs and helping Afghanistan recover from a challenging start. Afghanistan posted an impressive total of 221 runs, securing an eighth straight series victory over Zimbabwe. US declares national emergency in 13 states to secure power grid; what it means. US government has declared a national emergency to address security risks posed by foreign-made electricity equipment. An executive order has been signed, allowing tighter restrictions on potentially dangerous foreign equipment. The new measures aim to protect the national grid from cyberattacks and supply disruptions. This initiative could also boost domestic manufacturers as reliance on potentially vulnerable foreign suppliers is reduced. Halloween gatherings may trigger fresh violence: France to deploy 70k personnel. French Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez warned about the potential for urban violence during upcoming Halloween demonstrations. To manage this risk, around 70,000 police officers and gendarmes will be deployed across France. Demonstrations will be permitted, but not in city centres to prevent public disorder. Social media calls for gatherings have raised concerns about violence and unrest. Taylor Swift donated $100,000 to rebuild flood-hit Tennessee playground in 2010. In 2010, Taylor Swift made a significant contribution of $100,000 to help rebuild the Kids Kingdom playground in Hendersonville after it was severely damaged by flooding. Originally built in 1996, the playground had encountered numerous safety challenges. Currently, officials are looking into a $3 million grant aimed at enhancing recreational facilities, particularly focusing on developing an all-inclusive playground for children of varying abilities. NCLT, NCLAT hijacked by corporate affairs ministry: Supreme Court. In an outburst sure to embarrass the govt, Supreme Court Thursday slammed the ministry of corporate affairs for "completely hijacking" the two most important quasi-judicial financial adjudicatory bodies – National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) and the appellate NCLAT. World's largest crypto exchange Binance freezes $2.54bn after suspected hack. Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, said on Thursday that $2.54 billion worth of crypto assets had been frozen as it investigated a possible security breach. Sir Patrick Stewart dies at 86 after battle with Alzheimer's and Lewy body dementia. Sir Patrick Stewart, the celebrated British actor known for Star Trek: The Next Generation and the X-Men franchise, has died at 86 at his Los Angeles home, according to a family statement. His death follows a battle with Alzheimer's disease and Lewy body dementia. The acclaimed actor leaves behind a six-decade legacy across theatre, television and cinema. BJP MP Manoj Tiwari swims in Yamuna to give 'clean' message. BJP MP Manoj Tiwari swam in the Yamuna at Sonia Vihar, praising cleaning efforts before Chhath Puja. AAP challenged Tiwari's claims, stating the river water was heavily polluted and unsafe. Monitoring reports from DPCC indicate increased pollution levels compared to the previous year. The river's condition remains a political issue as devotees prepare for Chhath celebrations. Researchers find buried wood at Turkey site linked to Noah's Ark. Researchers investigating Turkey's ship-shaped Durupınar Formation claim to have found charred and uncharred wood nearly 30 feet underground. The team believes the findings could offer clues about the biblical Noah's Ark, but the discovery remains unverified. Earlier radar scans and soil analysis have also fuelled their claims, though independent scientific evidence is needed to establish the site's origins. Fired US general admits leaking classified Iran, Ukraine information to journalists. The US Army general fired by defence secretary Pete Hegseth admitted to leaking classified information about the wars in Iran and Ukraine to journalists over a period of roughly a year, according to an internal investigation report reviewed by Axios.

Unocoin Launches India's First Bitcoin Lending Service with Multisig Wallet Security. New Delhi , October 29: Unocoin, which has been serving Indian Bitcoin users since 2013 and has over 2.5 million registered users, today announced UnocoinXPledg, India's first Bitcoin lending service with multisig wallet security. Powered by Unocoin and available on pledg.in, the service helps eligible users pledge their Bitcoin and obtain personal loans in INR from a regulated non-banking financial company (NBFC). Until now, Indian Bitcoin holders who needed rupees had one practical option: sell. UnocoinXPledg gives them another option: instead of selling, HOLD BTC and get rupees for urgent needs. transcript.title: Money, tax and personal finance
transcript.text: Now to your money — taxes, savings and personal finance. Is EPFO set to invest in startups, AIFs? Report says provident fund body is working on guidelines. Employees' Provident Fund Organisation plans to establish rules for investments in alternative investment funds. The organization is considering allocating up to 3 percent of new annual accretions to AIFs for diverse investments. RBI raises Floating Rate Bond 2034 interest rate by 81 basis points; check revised rate for October 2026–April 2027. The RBI has raised the interest rate on the Government of India Floating Rate Bond 2034 for the six-month period from 30 October 2026 to 29 April 2027 by 81 basis points. Here's what the revised rate means for investors and how the bond works. Axis Bank to revise savings account charges from December 1, 2026: Free transaction limit to fall; EDGE Rewards Program to end; charges to rise. Axis Bank will implement a new fee structure affecting its domestic and NRI savings accounts. The free cash transaction limit will reduce from four to three transactions or rupees 1 lakh. Minimum balance penalties will also change, particularly for semi-urban and rural accounts due to increased maximum charges. Additionally, the EDGE REWARD program will be discontinued for several account categories. Income tax: Can your business income be clubbed with your husband's? ITAT ruling offers relief to woman. ITAT ruled in favour of a woman whose timber business was treated as her husband's family firm by the Income Tax Department. The tribunal found insufficient evidence linking the two businesses, highlighting the importance of proving ownership in tax disputes. DR rises by 3 percent to 63 percent : How will the hike impact pension, family pension and commuted pension? See calculations for basic pensions of rupees 10,000 to rupees 50,000. DR hike: On October 28, 2026, Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw heralded a notable 3 percent rise in dearness relief for pensioners, lifting the rate from 60 percent to 63 percent . This increase aims to provide substantial financial support to both regular and family pensioners. Those under the Old and Unified Pensioner Schemes will find their monthly pensions adjusted favorably, enhancing financial well-being for many retirees nationwide. India's HNI term insurance bookings double since 2023; younger buyers drive growth, shows new report. Term insurance bookings among high-net-worth individuals have doubled since April 2023, while average coverage has risen 30 percent , Policybazaar data shows. Details here. UPS rules clarified: What happens to pension contributions during employee's probation, suspension and absence from duty. Central government employees must contribute to the Unified Pension Scheme during probation, yet contributions during suspension are optional. The government continues contributions during suspension only if the employee opts to contribute as well. Employees on absence without pay are exempt from making any contributions at that time. Delayed contributions may be restored if the delay is not the subscriber's fault. Financial planning beyond mutual funds: 6 checks every investor should review annually to secure long-term goals. Financial planning goes beyond mutual funds. A 1 Finance report identifies six areas investors should review annually: estate planning, loans, investments, income and expenses, insurance, and tax. These checks can help protect wealth and keep long-term goals on track. Gold taxation explained: How much tax you pay on selling gold jewellery, ETFs, fund of funds and SGBs. Tax on capital gains from gold investment: Investing in gold can yield gains, but investors must be informed about the associated tax liabilities. Different types of gold investments, including physical gold, ETFs, and FoFs, have varying tax implications. Gold held for less than 24 months generates short-term capital gains, while long-term gains apply to gold held longer. Sovereign Gold Bonds (SGBs) have specific tax exemptions if held until maturity, which investors should note. DA hike news: 10-year growth - How central govt dearness allowance rate rose from 2 percent in 2016 to 63 percent in 2026 Explained. Central government employees' dearness allowance rose to 63 percent of basic pay in 2026 after a three-percentage-point increase. Here's a look at the allowance's growth over the past 10 years. EPFO plans to invest 3 percent of fresh inflows in startups and AIFs, five years after approval: What you need to know. EPFO is drawing up guidelines to invest up to 3 percent of fresh annual inflows in startups and alternative investment funds (AIFs), five years after government approval. The proposal is expected to go before its board in November. SBI credit card rule changes from December 1, 2026: 1 percent fee on high-value transportation and fuel transactions; what changes for you. From December 1, 2026, SBI Card users will incur extra charges on specific transportation and fuel transactions. This fee structure will impact regular SBI credit card users significantly. Flat possession delayed for nearly 10 years? Consumer court orders builder to refund rupees 45 lakh with 9 percent interest. A Mumbai consumer commission has ordered a developer to refund rupees 45.45 lakh to a homebuyer who waited nearly a decade for a Panvel flat, with 9 percent annual interest taking the payout to rupees 86.37 lakh. However, it rejected his claim for rupees 5.23 lakh in home loan interest. PM Kisan 24th instalment money payment tomorrow: How to check whether you received rupees 2000 or not? Steps to check online. Prime Minister Narendra Modi will release the 24th PM-Kisan instalment on October 30 at an event in Gujarat. Here's how to check the payment status. Is it time for India's HNI's and UHNIs to rethink their real estate portfolios?. For generations, families have measured real estate wealth by the number of properties they own, not the returns those assets deliver. That is beginning to change with the next generation asking sharper questions: What does each asset earn? How liquid is it? Is it worth holding? Selling a house to clear your home loan? What an ITAT ruling on a rupees 26 lakh cash advance means for property sellers. ITAT Chennai has deleted a rupees 26 lakh penalty on a salaried taxpayer who accepted a rupees 26 lakh cash advance while selling his house to repay an outstanding home loan. The tribunal cited reasonable cause, considering the genuine transaction and financial circumstances. rupees 20.45 lakh cash deposits, rupees 12.64 lakh capital gains from property sale questioned by Income Tax Department; here's why woman wins relief at ITAT Hyderabad. A Telangana woman successfully challenged an income-tax dispute involving substantial cash deposits and a property sale. The ITAT Hyderabad canceled most tax notices but left one aspect open for verification. Taxpayers can learn from this case about the importance of maintaining proper documentation for cash transactions and property ownership to avoid disputes with tax authorities. AI for personal finance: Can you trust artificial intelligence to manage your investments? What investors must know. AI can help investors identify costly funds, idle cash and gaps in financial planning, but it may not replace human judgement. A 1 Finance report says effective financial advice extends beyond investment returns to goal planning, behavioural coaching and monitoring changing financial needs. Saving for your child in 2026? The video is pretty unnerving, and fair warning that it gets a little graphic, but it's a fun one to watch if you're looking for something scary You don't need to believe in a god to get a religious exemption from using AI at work. David Durman, a University of Kentucky administrator, recently earned a religious exemption from using AI in the workplace. Six popular sugar substitutes linked to faster brain aging. A study of nearly 13,000 adults found that people consuming the most artificial sweeteners experienced a 62 percent faster decline in memory and thinking skills, equivalent to approximately 1.6 additional years of brain aging. Six popular sweeteners were linked to faster cognitive decline, raising concerns about the long-term brain health effects of common sugar substitutes, although causation was not established. Karbonn Rebel 5G teased on Amazon: How the Indian brand eyes comeback with affordable smartphones for Gen Z. Karbonn is making a comeback in India's smartphone market, targeting Gen Z and content creators with affordable devices amid rising smartphone prices. The homegrown brand has teased the Rebel 5G on Amazon, but its specifications, pricing and launch date remain unconfirmed. Intel says it's selling every affordable laptop chip it can make. Mathematicians have uncovered what they argue is a fundamental flaw in the standard model of the universe, potentially challenging the need for dark energy. Their calculations suggest that the mathematical framework used to describe cosmic expansion is inherently unstable and that the universe could accelerate naturally under Einstein's original theory of gravity. The findings also raise surprising questions about whether our location in the universe is as ordinary as scientists have long assumed. Artificial intelligence (AI)-led services are expected to generate between USD 100 billion and USD 200 billion in net new work by 2030, with technology services companies able to meet most of the demand by reskilling their existing employees, according to a report by Boston Consulting Group (BCG). But to do that it will have to continue on its capex spending spree, its CEO said Thursday. NASA discovers Jupiter's invisible shield is more complex than Earth's. NASA's Juno spacecraft has discovered that Jupiter uses a surprisingly complex system of powerful plasma waves and multiple shock regions to defend against the solar wind. The findings reveal major differences between Jupiter and Earth and could help scientists understand the enormous shock waves produced by exploding stars. Born in 1940 in Mirfield, Yorkshire, England, Binance pauses withdrawals as hackers suspected of stealing billions in crypto. Some estimates say hackers stole billions in crypto from Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, during a cyberattack on Thursday. 128,000-year-old ice in Tibet could rewrite climate history. Ancient ice discovered high in Tibet may be more than 128,000 years old, preserving an extraordinary record of Earth's climate that scientists previously thought had been lost. The discovery reveals a rare glimpse into the last ice age and could reshape our understanding of how glaciers survive dramatic changes in global climate. Reddit will force everyone to log in. Putin said that he and Musk are in "close contact" about Rassvet, Russia's Starlink-like satellite connectivity project. A 700,000-year-old elephant tooth reveals a lost world where early humans lived. A remarkably preserved elephant tooth dating back nearly 700,000 years has revealed a surprisingly lush prehistoric world where giant elephants and early humans lived side by side. Discovered in northern Israel alongside ancient stone tools, the tooth belonged to a straight-tusked elephant, one of the largest land mammals of the Ice Age. The biggest ouch of the report was its negative free cash flow of $2.4 billion. Less than 42 minutes of bright daylight linked to higher dementia risk. Getting more daylight could be linked to a surprisingly powerful benefit for brain health. In a study of more than 87,000 adults, researchers found that higher daytime light exposure was associated with a 16 percent lower risk of dementia, with longer exposure to bright light linked to even greater reductions. Remarkably, getting less than 42 minutes of bright daylight daily was a stronger predictor of dementia than six established risk factors. GM to pay $220 million to resolve claims it sold driving habits data. General Motors has agreed to pay $220 million to settle claims that it illegally sold driver and location information to data brokers, as reported earlier by Reuters. The agreement, which resolves a complaint from a coalition of 36 US attorneys general, requires GM to limit the driving data it collects and obtain "express consent" from GM reaches $220M settlement over selling drivers' private data. Pema Khandu asserted that border transgressions along the India-China frontier have been a longstanding issue, highlighting China's non-recognition of the McMahon Line. Convinced of bank personnel's complicity in cases of cyber fraudsters duping people by staging 'digital arrest', SC told Reserve Bank of India that its proposed Nov 30 standard operating procedure (SOP) must mandate every financial institution to indemnify those who lose money kept with banks to digital conmen. In a setback to J and K govt, the high court (HC) of Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh Thursday struck down the 2010 Water Resources Act, ruling that water usage charges levied on hydropower projects amounted to a tax on electricity generation, a subject beyond the erstwhile state legislature's powers.
